qualification.details: Junior Research Fellow: Post Graduate Degree in Basic Science or Graduate/Post Graduate Degree in Professional Course selected through National Eligibility Tests – CSIR-UGC NET/GATE or National level examinations conducted by Central Government Departments and their Agencies and Institutions such as DST, DBT, DAE, DOS, DRDO, MoE, ICAR, ICMR, IIT, IISc, IISER, NISER etc. Desirable: 1–2 years; skills in Python; quantum computing frameworks (Qiskit/PennyLane); machine/deep learning. Research Associate Provisional: Ph.D. Thesis Submitted. Desirable: 1–2 years; proficiency in Python, Qiskit/PennyLane, machine and deep learning techniques, and domain knowledge in space weather or astrophysics. Research Associate II: Ph.D. + 1 year of experience. Desirable: 1+ years of experience in quantum algorithms, hybrid quantum-classical models, and quantum hardware, with exposure to machine learning techniques and their applications in quantum computing.

content_sections.heading: IIT Indore Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the IIT Indore Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download IIT Indore Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: IIT Indore Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 12 vacancies are available - 9 for Junior Research Fellow, 1 for Research Associate Provisional and 2 for Research Associate II.

content_sections.heading: IIT Indore Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Junior Research Fellow: Post Graduate Degree in Basic Science or Graduate/Post Graduate Degree in Professional Course selected through National Eligibility Tests – CSIR-UGC NET/GATE or National level examinations conducted by Central Government Departments and their Agencies and Institutions such as DST, DBT, DAE, DOS, DRDO, MoE, ICAR, ICMR, IIT, IISc, IISER, NISER etc. Desirable: 1–2 years; skills in Python; quantum computing frameworks (Qiskit/PennyLane); machine/deep learning. Research Associate Provisional: Ph.D. Thesis Submitted. Desirable: 1–2 years; proficiency in Python, Qiskit/PennyLane, machine and deep learning techniques, and domain knowledge in space weather or astrophysics. Research Associate II: Ph.D. + 1 year of experience. Desirable: 1+ years of experience in quantum algorithms, hybrid quantum-classical models, and quantum hardware, with exposure to machine learning techniques and their applications in quantum computing.

content_sections.heading: IIT Indore Recruitment 2026 - Salary / Stipend
content_sections.text: Junior Research Fellow: ₹37,000 + HRA Per Month Research Associate Provisional: ₹45,000 + HRA Per Month Research Associate II: ₹61,000 + HRA Per Month

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IIT Indore Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 20-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Indore to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IIT Indore Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the IIT Indore Recruitment 2026 is 20th September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Junior Research Fellow posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 9 vacancies for the Junior Research Fellow post. In addition, there are 1 vacancy for Research Associate Provisional and 2 vacancies for Research Associate II.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for Junior Research Fellow?
faq.answer: The educational qualification for Junior Research Fellow is a Post Graduate Degree in Basic Science or a Graduate/Post Graduate Degree in a Professional Course selected through CSIR-UGC NET/GATE or equivalent national exams.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for IIT Indore Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for these positions?
faq.answer: The salary ranges from Rs. 37,000 to Rs. 61,000 per month, plus HRA, depending on the specific post.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for IIT Indore Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process for these posts will be based on an Interview.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Online. Candidates need to apply through the official website.

faq.question: Q8. Where is IIT Indore located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Technology Indore is located in Indore, Madhya Pradesh.

faq.question: Q9. Are there any desirable qualifications mentioned for the Research Associate posts?
faq.answer: Yes, desirable qualifications are mentioned, including proficiency in Python, quantum computing frameworks, machine learning, and domain knowledge in space weather or astrophysics for Research Associate Provisional, and experience in quantum algorithms and hybrid quantum-classical models for Research Associate II.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates with a Ph.D. thesis submitted apply for these posts?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates who have submitted their Ph.D. thesis are eligible to apply for the Research Associate Provisional post.
